name: inkroom
description: Create and edit AI images with InkRoom. Includes a remote MCP server and a Skill for previews, authorized execution, batches and original-image recovery. Requires your own InkRoom account and MCP Token.

INKROOM_MCP_TOKEN.title: InkRoom MCP Token
INKROOM_MCP_TOKEN.description: Your own InkRoom MCP Token from https://inkroom.ai/mcp-server, without the Bearer prefix. Image generation uses your account credits.
